description: Evidence-backed corrections to the approximate centre-field compass bearings used by the runtime venue registry and static park-geometry export.

source.imagery_date: The service describes CONUS source imagery from 2017-2021; the exact tile flight date was not exposed.

calculation.method: inverse Web Mercator pixel locations followed by initial great-circle bearings; centre-field axis estimated from the base-path bisector

LAD.uncertainty: Manual visual feature localization on a coarse basemap; the plus/minus 10 degree tolerance is a conservative interpretation bound, not a statistical confidence interval.
